rdfs:label: Alarm
rdfs:comment: A clock alarm — a recurring wake or reminder trigger at a wall-clock time. In practice a daily-recurring iCalendar Vevent carrying an embedded VALARM. RFC 5545 compatible.

sh:property.sh:description: The alarm's label (e.g. "Wake up"). Optional — an alarm needs no name.
First occurrence as RFC 5545 floating time — deliberately zoneless (not RFC 3339): the alarm fires at this wall-clock time in whatever timezone the device is in.
Recurrence rule (RFC 5545 RECUR). FREQ=DAILY for an everyday alarm; add BYDAY (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR) for weekday schedules.
CONFIRMED = enabled, CANCELLED = disabled. Calendars that hide CANCELLED events render a disabled alarm correctly.
Embedded iCalendar VALARM — the RFC 5545 alarm subcomponent that marks this event as one that rings.
